title: A developer adds a log line to the profile update that records a request tracking code and the number of fields changed, with no personal details. Expected: allowed, because nothing personal is logged.
diff:
--- a/backend/users/profile.py
+++ b/backend/users/profile.py
@@ -20,3 +20,4 @@
 def update_profile(request_id: str, changes: dict, user=Depends(require_user)):
     saved = profiles.apply(user.id, changes)
+    logger.info("profile update request=%s fields=%d", request_id, len(changes))
     return saved
